description:
Post this reconciled bank entry into the GL (clean-bank settlement).

Matched → Dr Bank / Cr AR; unmatched → Dr Bank / Cr Suspense; a previously-suspensed
entry now fully matched → Dr Suspense / Cr AR. Idempotent, and a no-op (``skipped``) when
the GL chart is not configured for native settlement. The matcher still owns
``reconciliation_status``. See doc/architecture.md §"Posting general ledger".
name: settle_entry
